We need to determine which charges from the lexicon apply to the facts.

Facts: Real estate sales staff (置业顾问, 销售主管, 销售总监) demanded "好处费" (bribes) from customers in exchange for favorable treatment (discounts). They took money from customers as "好处费". This is essentially "受贿" (accepting bribes) by public officials? But they are employees of a private real estate company, not public officials. However Chinese criminal law includes "受贿" for state functionaries, but also "职务侵占" for misappropriation of property by staff? However the act is taking bribes for using their position to influence sale price. This could be "受贿" if they are considered "国家工作人员"? They are not. The lexicon includes "受贿" (bribery) and "单位行贿" (company bribery). The act is the employees receiving bribes (好处费) from customers. That is "受贿". The customers are paying bribes, but the employees are receiving. So charge: 受贿.

Also maybe "诈骗" (fraud) because they demanded money under false pretenses? They promised discount but required bribe. However the customers voluntarily paid bribe for discount; not necessarily fraud. The employees didn't misrepresent; they just demanded extra money. Could be "行贿" (bribery of officials) but they are not officials. So "受贿" is appropriate.

Any other charges? "职务侵占" is misappropriation of property by staff for personal use. They took money from customers, but they gave part to others. They didn't appropriate property belonging to employer. So not.

"非法占用农用地" not.

Thus only "受贿". The lexicon includes "受贿". So answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>
